title: Deploy authenticated worker-lab canary submit route
mission: Under worker-lab's existing authenticated /proxy + NP_API_KEY front door, expose the narrow app-owned canary submit action needed by portfolio-chat-canary-auth-bridge-reuse-v1, without adding browser GitHub secrets or changing production promotion authority.
definition_of_done: A deployed authenticated worker-lab route exists for POST /proxy/prometeo/canary/submit or an explicitly documented app-native equivalent.
The route invokes the existing app-owned authenticated bridge and can submit exactly one safe /wc canary request.
A successful canary response exposes a stable invocation URL or durable receipt reference consumable by the predecessor job.
No user PAT, bot PAT, GitHub secret, or delegated credential is copied to the browser or committed to the repository.
Structured failures are returned without altering production promotion logic, scheduler authority, CURRENT, or worker-family architecture.
Verification includes one authenticated request through the deployed worker-lab front door and records the response/receipt or an exact external deployment boundary.
